values.summary: Classified and repaired both #208 regressions exposed by PR #230 hosted CI. The shared production runtime fixture now supplies the mandatory private continuity listener, isolated custody roots, exact five-participant bound, separate server/client EKU certificates, trust roots, and SPKI pins; readiness failures retain the child exit status and stderr. The tracked nextest policy now binds the exact 56 issue cases rather than absent binary-name selectors, is explicitly loaded by every standalone proof lane, and keeps a five-second result=fail pipe-closure bound justified by repeated loaded-host false classifications on resource-free cases. Fresh v4 evidence at 24543caa6fc43a5bfb47a12a7884cf3d6a4efda9 retains Runtime 21/21 and kernel 35/35 in two concurrent plus two isolated waves with zero LEAK, production ACIP 2/2, both strict Clippy lanes, exact 56/64/12 behavior parity, current-main ancestry, and clean diff hygiene. Typed recovery cleared stale review/publication truth; distinct exact-head rereview remains required before republishing PR #230.
actual_changes: Extended the shared production runtime-init fixture with an isolated loopback continuity listener, exact five-participant bound, private state/staging roots, dedicated ServerAuth and ClientAuth certificates, trust roots, and certificate SPKI pins; production readiness disconnects now report the child status and stderr.
Replaced nextest binary-name overrides with one exact ordered 56-case test filter so workspace and slow-proof selections that lack #208 binaries no longer fail configuration parsing.

Bound all standalone #208 proof lanes explicitly to the tracked nextest config and retained fail-on-leak semantics with a five-second loaded-host pipe-closure observation window plus the existing shared no-child teardown assertion.

Expanded the issue-owned producer and validator with the production ACIP 2-test lane and an exact workspace/slow-proof selector contract while retaining repeated isolated and concurrent zero-LEAK denominators.
